subject: lithuanian
summary: Lithuanian is the tidiest of the language decks sampled: short questions, the correct reading passage attached each time, and schemes broken into separate tickable points with a clear 'Any 2 of these - 2 marks each' header. Lithuanian letters (ą, ę, ė, į, š, ų, ž) render correctly. The real faults are a multiple-choice question whose four options are run into the sentence with no separation, an English-answer scheme that keeps the examiner's slash-separated alternatives, and an orange underline on the question that starts and stops mid-sentence. The phone has the same empty band under the attachment button as the other language subjects.

issues.title: Multiple-choice options run into the question
issues.detail: The question is a sentence to complete with one of four tick-box options, but it is printed as a single line: 'Vaikinas buvo vyresnis (1 dalis) 11 metų 12 metų 15 metų 13 metų'. Nothing tells the student these are four choices, and the whole line is underlined in orange.
issues.suggested_fix: Show the stem on one line and the four options as a lettered or bulleted list beneath it.

issues.title: Orange underline starts and stops mid-sentence
issues.detail: The underline on the question text has wrong boundaries. On card 8 it begins at the last word of the first sentence ('name? Parašykite dvi profesijas. (2 dalis)'); on card 1 it covers 'Discuss. Refer to the text in support of your answer. (Answer' and stops one word into the bracket. On other cards it underlines the entire question, which makes it meaningless as an emphasis.
issues.suggested_fix: Underline only the instruction phrase on whole-sentence boundaries, or remove the underline for non-English question text.

issues.title: Slash-separated alternatives in the scheme
issues.detail: The 10-mark English-answer scheme is two blocks of examiner shorthand: 'AGREE. Bicycles have sentimental value / they have names / she loves them as people / sense of freedom and love / ... Etc.' On the phone each block is seven lines of slash-joined fragments. Card 7 has a milder version ('Naujumu kvepiantys / nauji').
issues.suggested_fix: Under 'Agree' and 'Disagree' headings, list each acceptable idea as its own bullet; drop the trailing 'Etc.' or replace it with 'or similar'.

issues.title: Part-mark rule hidden in a grey note
issues.detail: The one-point scheme shows a single 4-mark tick box, while the fact that a shorter answer earns 2 marks is buried at the end of a six-line grey note that mostly repeats the answer-in-Lithuanian rule.
issues.suggested_fix: Show 'Full answer 4 marks; "Du žaidėjai" or "Šeši žaidėjai" alone 2 marks' as its own line, separate from the language note.

issues.title: Empty band and cut-off footer
issues.detail: On the phone there are about 200 pixels of blank space between the attachment button and the answer box on every card. In the reader, the footer note is cut off with an ellipsis ('The scheme awards half marks for an ans...'). The section label '(3 dalis)' in the question is not explained as 'paragraph 3 of the passage'.
issues.suggested_fix: Collapse the gap; let the reader footer wrap to two lines.
